verdict.rationale: Asking whether a device-control agent can target several operating systems is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows the agent controlling a real iPhone (iOS). The Mac-side board_test.py is a debugging tool for the board, not a second agent target, and no per-target support for macOS, Windows, Linux or Android is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, the same agent targets more than one OS (macOS, Windows, Linux, or mobile) with documented per-target support
